in_marathi.name: Jyothsna
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess of Wisdom and Knowledge
in_marathi.long_meaning: Jyothsna हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Jyothsna is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘jyot’, meaning ‘light’ or ‘knowledge’. The suffix ‘sna’ denotes a female form, making Jyothsna the embodiment of wisdom and knowledge in Hindu mythology.
